cityGraph.movement: No colour restriction for Drive/Ferry. Drawn lines only encode printed adjacency; card flights/shuttles are different actions and are not fabricated map edges.

cures.display: uncured markers beside indicator; cured vial on indicator; eradicated flip of SAME marker, not a second piece

physicalObjects.pawnOwners: Active players only, with public role and matching role pawn colour. Inactive role pawns/cards are set aside, never placed as extra players.
physicalObjects.cubeColour: A city may contain multiple disease colours; city native colour does not restrict saved cubes. Each colour uses the same global24cube inventory.
physicalObjects.sameCardIdentity: A card moves between exactly one deck/hand/discard/resolution/removed/stored zone. Contingency Planner stored Event is not part of hand; after use remove it rather than duplicate/discard.

visibility.handMode: introductory4epidemics=open; standard5/heroic6=owner-hidden, with optional agreed-open mode explicitly chosen
visibility.playerDeck: hidden order unknown unless independently recorded for authorized resume
visibility.infectionDeck: hidden order unknown except an actual Forecast window; do not reveal unknown deck by inferred setup
visibility.cardPopulations: tie-break source data only; not used to invent unknown active turn

fieldBindings.world.scene: cities with all pawns/stations/colour cubes and supplies
fieldBindings.decks.scene: shared physical deck/discard metadata; no fake public catalog binding
fieldBindings.outbreak: outbreakCount; retain original opaque bytes when consuming an existing save

tableModel.ruleAutomation: No legal-move engine, automatic cube placement/cure/eradication, outbreak-chain execution, event timing, hidden-deck reconstruction, forced hand deletion, role effects, win/loss or score determination. State can represent these without executing them.

diagramOnly: Guide card/cube/pawn silhouettes are placement examples, not actual current quantities.
No commercial geography, logo, card text or character art is reproduced.
